item.title: ICE officer training is ‘deficient’ and ‘broken,’ former agency lawyer tells congressional forum
item.description: A former Immigration and Customs Enforcement lawyer says the agency’s training for new deportation officers is broken as ICE ramps up its hiring. Ryan Schwank was testifying Monday during a public forum hosted by Democratic Sen. Richard Blumenthal and Rep. Robert Garcia. Schwank says the basic training program is “deficient” and officers need clear limits on their authority. item.description: The British Academy Film Awards and BBC have apologized Monday for a racial slur that was broadcast during Sunday’s show while two stars of the film “Sinners” were onstage. item.title: WNBA says March 10 deadline needed for new CBA to avoid delaying May 8 season start, AP source says
item.description: The WNBA told the players’ union that it needs to get a deal in place by March 10 start the season on time. That's according to a person familiar with the discussions who told The Associated Press about the Monday meeting on condition of anonymity because of the sensitive nature of the negotiations. It was the first meeting between the sides that involved players and the league since they met at the WNBA offices on Feb. 2. item.title: Body of civil rights leader Jesse Jackson is to lie in state in South Carolina
item.description: The Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. is being honored in South Carolina, where he was born and where his civil rights work began as a teenager. Next Monday his body will lie in state at the South Carolina Statehouse. Jackson died on Feb. 17 from a rare neurological disorder. He will lie in repose this week at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition in Chicago before being honored in South Carolina. item.title: Floyd Mayweather and Manny Pacquiao agree to a rematch in September at The Sphere in Las Vegas
item.description: Floyd Mayweather and Manny Pacquiao have agreed to a rematch of their landmark 2015 bout. Their second fight will be held Sept. 19 in Las Vegas. The fight will be streamed on Netflix, and it will be the first boxing match to be held at The Sphere, the immersive event venue east of the Strip. Mayweather turns 49 years old on Tuesday. item.title: More Ghanaians are wearing a cultural outfit after their president was mocked
item.description: More Ghanaians are wearing the colorful fugu traditional outfit in a trend triggered by online mockery. Ghana’s President John Dramani Mahama in early February visited Zambia wearing a fugu smock, prompting ridicule from some social media users. Tourism Minister Abla Dzifa Gomashie then declared Wednesdays as “Fugu Day”. item.title: Supersub strikes again as Sesko gives Man United win at Everton
item.description: Manchester United supersub Benjamin Sesko has given Manchester United a 1-0 win at Everton in the Premier League. The Slovenian striker came off the bench to coolly slide his shot past Jordan Pickford and give interim boss Michael Carrick a fifth win in six games since his appointment in January. The result takes United three points clear of Chelsea and Liverpool in fourth place. Everton remains in ninth and without a home win in seven matches. item.title: For Northeast blizzard, everything was just right to roll up a monster snowfall
item.description: Meteorologists say the powerful nor’easter smacking the Northeast is a classic, record-setting blizzard. Experts on Monday described it as the strongest in a decade, as strong as a Category 2 hurricane but in the winter. And they said it hit the perfect setup for heavy, wet snow, with the temperature in a narrow sweet spot and the storm track in just the right spot near the ocean to gather moisture and power. item.title: US stocks drop after Trump ramps up his tariffs and investors dump potential AI losers
item.description: U.S. stocks slumped after President Donald Trump ramped up his newest tariffs, while investors continued to punish companies that could be losers in the artificial-intelligence revolution. The S&P 500 sank 1% Monday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.7%, and the Nasdaq composite fell 1.1%. Cybersecurity and software stocks fell to some of the market’s sharpest losses on worries AI-powered rivals could undercut their profits.
